scenes: North Korea is making its own meme coins.
October twenty-ninth. Hackers took six point four billion dollars from Binance in under four hours.
About two point eight five billion dollars was frozen in time.
About three billion dollars is still out there. Now they are moving it.
Over twenty thousand wallets. sixteen blockchains.
The newest trick: worthless meme coins they create themselves.
They trade them through pools. The money never goes wallet to wallet.
On N E A R alone: six home-made tokens. About four hundred thirty thousand dollars pushed through.
After the Bye-bit hack, four hundred ninety-nine thousand ether vanished in ten days.
So when a strange new coin appears overnight, ask who made it.
